instruction: Open-choice CLI requirement: This environment provides three candidate engineering toolchains, including BIM-capable tools and a distractor tool. Choose an appropriate BIM-capable command-line or official automation workflow from these options to edit C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and export the completed IFC4 deliverable as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside the selected BIM toolchain. The current model is a single-storey early-years centre with classrooms, a play hall, nap room, staff area, toilets, and an outdoor yard. Licensing review asks for a small sick bay and a calm room close to staff supervision, while preserving the yard, play hall, roof form, and classroom arrangement. Add the new support spaces with suitable access and daylight records for operational handover.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
